compute_pairwise_distances: compute pairwise distances between two sets of vectors using exact or approximate methods
compute_batch_distances: compute batched pairwise distances between two 3D tensor sets with memory-efficient chunking
save_and_load_model: save a PyTorch model checkpoint with optimizer and scheduler state or load it back
compute_corrected_mse: compute the mean squared error between two vector sets corrected with a normalization scale factor
unwrap_distributed_model: unwrap a PyTorch model from DistributedDataParallel or FullyShardedDataParallel wrappers
